name: Student Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an acceptance letter from the educational institution and an acceptance letter from the Ministry of Education.
Approval must be obtained before arrival -- visitors who arrive on a vacation/visitor basis cannot change their status to student after entry.
Requires proof of financial support for the duration of study.
Current health insurance covering the student individually is required.

evidence_required.document: Institution acceptance letter and Ministry of Education acceptance letter
Health certificate and individual health insurance

sources.title: Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Student Permit FAQs: eligibility, required documents, annual renewal with school report, no paid or unpaid work, internship/work-permit exception
Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Residency Permit FAQs: students may apply for a Resident Permit after 1 year at a tertiary institution

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Antigua and Barbuda's initial build. No work rights at all while on a pure student permit -- not even part-time -- unlike many countries' student routes in this dataset; internships exceeding 3 months that are integral to the course of study, or approved research programs, require a separate work permit rather than being folded into the student permit itself. leads_to_pr is modelled as true at 12 months specifically for tertiary-level students, per the Residency Permit FAQ's distinct 'students: after 1 year at a tertiary institution' ground -- see ag_resident_permit_general.json for how that ground sits alongside the other Resident Permit grounds. Renewal requires a sealed report from the school principal covering grades, attendance, and disciplinary record -- a distinctive continuous-good-standing check not seen in this form in other countries built this session.
